# Education

```{=latex}
\cventry{2016 – 2019}{
  \textbf{PhD, University of Oviedo -- Doctoral Programme in
  Chemical, Environmental and Biofood Engineering.}
  \textbf{\textit{Cum laude}} and
  \textbf{International Doctorate distinction}.
  Defended on 5 July 2019.\par
  \textbf{Thesis:} \textit{Análisis y evaluación del origen,
  componentes socioculturales y riesgos biológicos de la basura
  marina en el litoral asturiano}.\par
  \textbf{Supervisors:} Dr Eva García Vázquez and
  Dr Eduardo Dopico Rodríguez.
  \begin{itemize}
    \item Integrated coastal zone management; assessment of
    the threat posed by marine litter.
    \item Monitoring and management of invasive species;
    social implications of coastal biological impacts.
  \end{itemize}
}

\cventry{2015 – 2016}{
  \textbf{Master's Degree in Marine Conservation --
  University of Oviedo (taught in English).}\par
  \textbf{Master's thesis:} \textit{Social perception of biotic
  and abiotic marine pollution in the Cantabrian coast.
  A socioenvironmental approach}.\par
  \textbf{External placement:} 18 ECTS; grade 9.3/10.\par
  \textbf{Coursework:} integrated coastal zone management,
  marine protected areas, aquaculture, biological invasions,
  global change, impact assessment, GIS, and remote sensing.
}

\cventry{2009 – 2015}{
  \textbf{Bachelor's Degree in Biology -- University of Oviedo.}\par
  \textbf{Bachelor's thesis:} \textit{Diversidad y función de aves
  insectívoras en cultivos de manzano de sidra}.\par
  \textbf{Supervisors:} Dr Daniel García García and
  Dr Marcos Miñarro Prado (SERIDA).
}
```

# Software and data

```{=latex}
\cventry{2026}{
  \textbf{Rayón-Viña, F.}, Finkel, Z.V. \& Irwin, A.J. (2026).
  \textit{Phyto-MAP, a curated database of marine phytoplankton
  abundance records} [Data set]. Zenodo.
  Relational database of marine phytoplankton abundance,
  with harmonised observations, metadata, and technical-validation
  documentation. Available in SQLite and CSV formats.
  \href{[https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23424052](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23424052)}{doi:10.5281/zenodo.23424052}
}

\cventry{}{
  \textbf{Rayón Viña, F.} (2026).
  \textit{Phyto-MAP data-processing scripts} [Computer software].
  Zenodo. Scripts for source-specific data processing,
  taxonomic curation, and construction of the Phyto-MAP
  relational database, accompanied by workflow documentation.
  \href{[https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23351062](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23351062)}{doi:10.5281/zenodo.23351062}.
  \href{[https://github.com/RayonVina/phytomap-scripts](https://github.com/RayonVina/phytomap-scripts)}{Code on GitHub}
}

\cventry{}{
  \textbf{Rayón Viña, F.} (2026).
  \textit{phytaxr: Phytoplankton Taxonomic Curation Tools}
  [R package]. Zenodo.
  Tools for cleaning, standardising, and resolving phytoplankton
  taxon names, with automated resolution and interactive review
  of approximate matches.
  \href{[https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21905974](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21905974)}{doi:10.5281/zenodo.21905974}.
  \href{[https://github.com/RayonVina/phytaxr](https://github.com/RayonVina/phytaxr)}{Code on GitHub}
}
```

# Tools and skills

```{=latex}
\begin{itemize}
  \item \textbf{Data analysis and statistics:}
  R (tidyverse, Shiny, R Markdown/Quarto),
  Python (NumPy, pandas, matplotlib).

  \item \textbf{Databases:}
  PostgreSQL (design, administration, and maintenance),
  SQLite, SQL, and DBeaver.

  \item \textbf{Methods:}
  time-series and spectral analysis (\textit{wavelets});
  GIS and mapping with QGIS.

  \item \textbf{Computing and version control:}
  Linux, Bash/zsh, high-performance computing
  (CESGA FinisTerrae III);
  Git, GitHub, and GitLab.

  \item \textbf{Documents and web:}
  LaTeX, Markdown, HTML, and CSS;
  LibreOffice / Microsoft Office.

  \item \textbf{Laboratory, field, and social science methods:}
  DNA extraction, PCR, DNA barcoding, and environmental DNA;
  marine litter sampling;
  questionnaires.
\end{itemize}
```
